Calculating E quilibrium Compositions W hen K I s Known

The law of mass action relates the equilibrium composition to the equilibrium constant. We can use these expressions to predict the outcomes of chemical reac- tions. How to approach the problem depends on the type of experimental data available.
Suppose you are asked to determine the partial pressures of reactants and prod- ucts at equilibrium, given initial partial pressures of the reactants. This is illustrated by the following example.
